```{r}
# setsize_9_desc_data <- read_csv("many-item-single-choice/data/summary_files/setsize-9_desc-data.csv")
#we need to read in all the liking data for each subject

temp = list.files(path = here("many-item-single-choice","data","subject_files"), pattern="liking_ratings", full.names = T)

myfiles <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(temp))
for (idx in seq_along(myfiles)){
  myfiles[[idx]] = readr::read_csv(temp[[idx]])
  # temp = read_csv(temp[idx])
  # myfiles <- rbind(myfiles, temp)
}

rating_data <-plyr::ldply(myfiles, data.frame) 
rating_data$rating <- rating_data$rating + 4

rating_network <- rating_data %>% 
  select(subject,stimulus, rating) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = stimulus, values_from = rating) %>% select(-1)

names(rating_network)[order(names(rating_network))]

rating_network
```

```{r load self_control data}
temp = list.files(path = "/Users/kiantefernandez/Downloads/Self Control", pattern="exp_rating_data", full.names = T)

myfiles <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(temp))
for (idx in seq_along(myfiles)){
  myfiles[[idx]] = readr::read_csv(temp[[idx]])
  # temp = read_csv(temp[idx])
  # myfiles <- rbind(myfiles, temp)
}
rating_data <-plyr::ldply(myfiles, data.frame) 

table(factor(rating_data$PicID))
names(rating_data)
rating_network <- rating_data %>% 
  select(SubjectNumber,PicID, TasteRating) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = PicID, values_from = TasteRating) %>% select(-1)

final.self_control <- SemNeT::finalize(rating_network, minCase = 2)
cosine.self_control  <- SemNeT::similarity(final.self_control, method = "cosine")
net.self_control <- SemNeT::TMFG(cosine.self_control)

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggcorrplot)
library(corrplot)

# calulate the correlations
r <- cor(rating_network, use="complete.obs")
corrplot(r, method="color", type="upper", order="hclust")

ggcorrplot(r, 
           type = "upper")

TEST <- correlation::correlation(rating_network)
corrplot(M, type="upper", order="hclust")

x <- TEST[order(TEST$r, decreasing = T),]
min(TEST$r)
```

```{r}

test <- Matrix::nearPD(cor(rating_network))
########################
#Network estimation
#Gaussian graphical models
Perference_self_control <- estimateNetwork(rating_network, 
                           default = "ggmModSelect",
                           start = "empty",
                           considerPerStep = "all",
                           nCores = 8,
                           stepwise = TRUE,
                           verbose = FALSE)

ega_rating    <- EGA(rating_network, model = "glasso", plot.EGA = TRUE) 

```
